correctness.rationale: Exact rational simple-reflection matrices enumerate W(F4) of order 1152, reflection-codimension histogram (1,24,190,552,385). Rank test identifies NC ranks (1,24,55,24,1), proper chain counts (103,468,432). Conjugation by c6=-I yields effective C6; exact orbit cell counts (19,78,72). Independently rebuilt rational matrices and all intervals/chains/orbit boundary matrices: D1 rank18 Smith ones only, D2 rank60 Smith ones only, D1D2=0, so H1=0 and H2=Z^12. Noncrossing shellability gives simply-connected covering X; rank-two/other fixed vertex orbits size 2 and 3 have stabilizers C3 and C2 generating C6. Armstrong orbit fundamental-group theorem then gives pi1(Y)=1; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead upgrade the 2D CW homology to wedge of 12 S². Bounded enumeration is exhaustive for this exact finite W(F4), not an infinite type claim.
